The dspk package, module by module: what each function takes and returns.

| Module | What it is for |
|---|---|
| [`dspk.runtime`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/runtime/) | Compute runtime choice. |
| [`dspk.io`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/io/) | Recordings. |
| [`dspk.ops.filter`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/ops-filter/) | Filters on the device, one module per family (mirroring `dspk_ops::filter`). |
| [`dspk.ops.resample`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/ops-resample/) | Sample-rate changes on the device, with `scipy.signal.decimate` / `resample_poly` semantics. |
| [`dspk.ops.spatial`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/ops-spatial/) | Operations across channels on the device. |
| [`dspk.ops.math`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/ops-math/) | Per-channel statistics on the device, and window designs. |
| [`dspk.ops.linalg`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/ops-linalg/) | Models fitted on the device. |
| [`dspk.ops.layout`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/ops-layout/) | Channels in a new order on the device, and channel maps. |
| [`dspk.ops.peaks`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/ops-peaks/) | Peak candidates on the device. |
| [`dspk.ops.stage`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/ops-stage/) | Pipeline stages (see `dspk.ops.Pipeline`). |
| [`dspk.pipeline`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/pipeline/) | Pipelines as data. |
| [`dspk.custom`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/custom/) | Custom operations. |
| [`dspk.remote`](/dsp-kitchen/reference/python/remote/) | A client of `dspk serve`. |
